paragraphs: Mentioned in Tanchuma, Bereshit 10, asking R' Shmuel. Hyman reports that Bereshit Rabbah 50:4 reads: R' Shimon ben Yehotzadak asked ר״ש bar Nachmani.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: ר״ש could be Shmuel from the earlier addressee or Shimon; the previous bounded Midrash Rabbah--TE 50:4 check did not find the asserted question. That prior nonmatch is retained as an attributed check, not a fresh search or proof across editions. With conflicting/absent resolution, the final initials remain literal rather than choosing a name or full title.
בראשית-י/פ״נ-ד give Bereshit 10/50:4 as source labels, without a newly verified modern correspondence.
The headed Natan is the natural implicit Tanchuma asker, distinct from the reported parallel’s Shimon. No identity is inferred, and all three written-out-name titles remain R'.
